### Headline summary
- Anthropic is making major moves in both corporate structure and infrastructure, committing 5% of shares to a public benefit fund and negotiating a $45 billion cloud deal with Nscale. ([Analytics India Magazine](https://analyticsindiamag.com/ai-news/anthropic-to-set-aside-5-stock-for-new-public-benefit-fund), [Silicon RepublicSilicon Republic](https://www.siliconrepublic.com/business/anthropic-public-benefit-fund-to-target-public-good-ai-claude), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-19/nscale-anthropic-in-talks-for-45-billion-cloud-computing-deal), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261019/p41#a261019p41))
- Geopolitical tensions in the AI sector escalated as the US banned DeepSeek from federal systems and China proposed export controls on 23 advanced AI technologies. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-19/us-moves-to-bar-deepseek-from-federal-agencies-and-contracts), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.reuters.com/technology/us-banning-chinese-ai-deepseek-government-agency-it-systems-2026-10-19/), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://wallhop.io/https://www.theepochtimes.com//china/china-plans-to-tighten-export-controls-on-ai-technologies-6104786), [Analytics India Magazine](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jtGnIR_ht1A))
- The industry saw significant capital flows and security incidents, including a $1.5 billion raise by Tenstorrent and reports of AI agents breaching corporate networks in India and at Deere. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-19/ai-chip-startup-tenstorrent-raises-funds-at-6-2-billion-value), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261019/p18#a261019p18), [Analytics India Magazine](https://analyticsindiamag.com/ai-features/ai-agent-breach-exposes-flaws-in-indias-autonomous-system-defences), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261019/p22#a261019p22))

### Anthropic commits 5% of shares to public benefit fund
Anthropic announced it will commit 5% of its shares to a public benefit fund, a move described by some outlets as a pay package for the public or a proposal for AI wealth sharing. ([Analytics India Magazine](https://analyticsindiamag.com/ai-news/anthropic-to-set-aside-5-stock-for-new-public-benefit-fund), [Silicon RepublicSilicon Republic](https://www.siliconrepublic.com/business/anthropic-public-benefit-fund-to-target-public-good-ai-claude), [The Rundown AI](https://therundownai.beehiiv.com/p/anthropic-designs-a-pay-package-for-the-public), [Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/what-smart-people-are-saying-about-anthropic-5-pledge-2026-10))

### OpenAI engineer detained on espionage charges
An OpenAI engineer was detained on espionage charges, with reports linking the incident to Saudi Arabia. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261019/p26#a261019p26), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-19/doj-calls-for-detaining-openai-engineer-citing-saudi-ties), [International Business Times](https://www.ibtimes.com/saudi-national-who-bugged-openai-conference-room-communicated-royal-family-member-before-arrest-3808724), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/employee-bugged-openai-saudi-royal-ties-u-s-prosecutors-say))

### US bans DeepSeek from federal agency systems
The US Department of Homeland Security ordered all federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek technology from their IT systems and prohibited future procurement of its products and services. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-19/us-moves-to-bar-deepseek-from-federal-agencies-and-contracts), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.reuters.com/technology/us-banning-chinese-ai-deepseek-government-agency-it-systems-2026-10-19/), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261019/p28#a261019p28))

### Nscale in talks for $45B Anthropic cloud deal
Nscale is in negotiations to sell computing power to Anthropic in a deal worth approximately $45 billion, which would involve delivering 460MW of computing power using Vera Rubin chips. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-19/nscale-anthropic-in-talks-for-45-billion-cloud-computing-deal), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261019/p41#a261019p41))

### Tenstorrent raises $1.5B Series E at $6.2B valuation
AI chip startup Tenstorrent closed a $1.5 billion Series E funding round led by Trace Capital and Innovation X, reaching a post-money valuation of $6.2 billion. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-19/ai-chip-startup-tenstorrent-raises-funds-at-6-2-billion-value), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261019/p18#a261019p18), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/19/tenstorrent-hits-6-2b-valuation-to-scale-open-weight-ai-chips/), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/tenstorrent-raises-1-5b-series-e-at-6-2b-valuation-to-scale-ai-compute/))

### AI agents breach Indian corporate networks and Deere
AI agents entered live Indian corporate networks without detection, exposing flaws in autonomous system defences, while a hacker also used AI agents to breach Deere and SharkNinja. ([Analytics India Magazine](https://analyticsindiamag.com/ai-features/ai-agent-breach-exposes-flaws-in-indias-autonomous-system-defences), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261019/p22#a261019p22), [Analytics India Magazine](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Wt18EX_Vizc), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1013643/ai-agents-hack-john-deere-shark-ninja-cummins))

### China proposes export controls on 23 AI technologies
China has proposed new export controls on 23 advanced AI technologies, a move that intensifies the technological rivalry with the United States. ([Hacker News (AI tag)](https://wallhop.io/https://www.theepochtimes.com//china/china-plans-to-tighten-export-controls-on-ai-technologies-6104786), [Analytics India Magazine](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jtGnIR_ht1A))

### Meta details Prometheus supercluster scaling to 1M GPUs
Meta published technical details on its Prometheus supercluster in Ohio, a gigawatt-scale facility that will support approximately one million GPUs at full scale and was used to train its Muse foundational models. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261019/p40#a261019p40), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/meta-details-prometheus-supercluster-scaling-toward-1-million-gpus/))
